purpose: discovery only; frozen EDHREC snapshots untouched
caveats: EDHREC inclusion = num_decks/potential_decks; usage is discovery evidence only, never an instruction. Jeleva is a fringe cEDH commander: the cEDH page is a very small sample (30 decks), so differences of a few decks are noise; the general page (about 3222 decks) is dominated by casual spellslinger lists whose top cards (Cyclonic Rift, Mizzix's Mastery, Etali, Expropriate, Mana Drain, Time Stretch and similar) were removed or rejected by the owner in the 2026-10-14 rebuild and are inadmissible here. Cards absent from every page are recorded as OFF-RANKING.
